The '''sacred spire''' was a natural peak around which the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was built on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Once a sacred place to the native [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]], the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] contained a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] which was contained within huge, [[Color/Legends|black]] stone walls.

==History==
The sacred spire was a site of worship for the early natives of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Following the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was granted use of the land surrounding and including the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]]. Initially, the Order only established small meditative chapels within and on the mountain. Over time however, as the Order moved to establish an [[Jedi academy|academy]] on Coruscant, the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]] began to expand the Temple. As the Temple grew, the area around it also rose to a modern "ground level" which would come to be known as the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple district]] over which the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] had sovereignty. Upon the slopes of the mountain, the foundations of the Temple Ziggurat were constructed and the Temple took on its modern appearance.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

As the sacred spire began to be surrounded by the Precinct and the peak by the Temple Ziggurat, the Order built the [[Temple Spire/Legends|Temple Spire]] over the summit, using that area for the training of the youngest [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]]. Suspended by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]], huge [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] memorial statues hung over the peak for the next thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. On the slope of the mountain, the High Council maintained the [[Chamber of Conclave/Legends|Chamber of Conclave]], a room used for annual conclaves with outlying [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />

Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Temple was placed [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|under siege]] by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] under the order of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] who, in reality, was [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious. Led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] exterminated all of the Jedi in the Temple. The edifice lay in silence over the next few [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] with only a small force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] maintaining guard.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] Darth Vader's secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], entered the building and quickly slaughtered the stormtrooper guard. Making his way to the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]], Starkiller passed through a hole in the floor into one of the old meditation chapels. Walking on the slopes of the sacred spire, Starkiller quickly made his way up through the ceiling to the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] that would access the Tower.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

The sacred spire would stand in silence for several more decades, slowly crumbling from disuse and lack of care. When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] Darth Sidious and Vader were slain, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] lost balance and was eventually [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|driven]] from Coruscant by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Coruscant was devastated by [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]], causing the Temple to crumble and reveal parts of the foundation, including the Spire. While occupied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], the Spire was targeted by the deranged [[Irek Ismaren]] who was going by the name "[[Lord Nyax]]." Ensnaring a following of slaves through fear, Nyax brought his followers and a host of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to the black wall that surrounded the Force-nexus in hopes that they could break into the mountain. As the wall was cracked, Nyax was [[Attack on the Sacred Spire|confronted]] by three members of the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Jedi Order]]: [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his [[Mara Jade Skywalker|wife]], and [[Tahiri Veila]]. Using the nexus to enhance his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], Nyax began to hurl boulders at the group. While Nyax maintained the upper hand for a time, the Skywalkers and Veila were eventually able to turn the Force against him and destroy Nyax. Before he died however, Nyax imbued the nexus with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, the captured Jedi [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was led to the Temple ruins by the mysterious [[Vergere]]. While within the ruins, Vergere manipulated the recent events to portray the Order as corrupt, building their Temple over a large dark side nexus. Confused, Solo continued on with Vergere, leaving the ruined complex.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>
